'''Chol''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Cholganna system/Legends|Cholganna system]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It orbited the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Cholganna system's sun|Chol]], with three larger planets orbiting further away than it, [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]], [[Ryien]] and [[Be'ekk]]. It was [[Color/Legends|brown]] in color. The Cholganna system was partially engulfed by the [[Chol Nebula/Legends|Chol Nebula]], and the planets in the [[Star system/Legends|Star system]] passed through the [[Nebula/Legends|nebula]] during their orbit.<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Chol first appeared in [[2013]] in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'' an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] roleplaying game, ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''.
